'''Corkash Fenc''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who lived during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Fenc was a member of the [[Intarsa League]], a criminal faction led by the [[Force Adept]] [[Dersa Welles]], and in around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]] he accompanied the league on a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] journey to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. However, the League had incurred the ire of a rival criminal faction and their [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] was attacked, leading them to crash-land on Cularin within the grounds of the [[Blue Star Centre]], a [[Philosopher/Legends|philosophical]] research facility. The Intarsa League quickly seized control of the Blue Star Centre and held its' inhabitants hostage. However, the [[Heroes of Cularin]]&mdash;a band of freelance operatives that operated within the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]&mdash;[[Skirmish in the Blue Star Centre|attacked]] the Intarsa League and attempted to liberate the hostages. Fenc engaged the freelancers in combat and during the conclusion of the raid Fenc lost control of his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], spraying blaster fire across the room and injuring several of the hostages. Fenc and the Intarsa League were ultimately defeated and the hostages were liberated.
